jsonValueNavigation.enterNestedContainer.description: Navigate into non-empty JSON objects and arrays instead of treating each container as a single value.

jsonValueNavigation.iterateContainerItem.description: When entering nested containers, navigate through inner values one by one. If disabled, arrays/objects are selected as whole values.

jsonValueNavigation.ignoreTopLevelArrayW.description: Treat a single top-level JSON array as a wrapper. Its immediate items are navigable even when nested container traversal is disabled.

jsonValueNavigation.minNestingLevel.description: Minimum JSON nesting level to include in navigation targets. Root value is level 0, its direct children are level 1, etc.
